name: The Langå railway bridges
description: The two bridges over the Gudenå at Langå, blown by the six on the night of 17 November 1943. Supply line to 350,000 men in Norway. Blown up twice (1864 and 1943).
notes: Charges: Bak calculated 75 kg of Nobel 808 on the bearings and main girders; the info board says 80 kg. Blasts at 5.25, 6.15, 7.35, 9.41. Two reserve police guards tied to a post out of blast range.
